_comment: Deployed source retrieved via JSON-RPC gen_getContractCode (base64-encoded) and compared to the repository file byte for byte.
what_this_version_adds: file_claim requires embedded uri: and sha256: evidence anchors; audit re-derives and consensus-echoes them (fail closed on mismatch)
every claim snapshots the agent's liability table at filing; audit, requeue and arbitration settle from the bound table only
open claims freeze the bond: delist_agent and update_liabilities revert until final resolution
dispute gating: funded outcomes stay disputable, one open dispute per claim, stale disputes cannot resolve, requeue closes without settling, settlement nets against paid_out
